description: This is an HTML source file that constructs the frontend interface for a Database Viewer web application. It contains HTML structure, CSS styles, and JavaScript code to display available databases, tables, and data, and to facilitate user interactions such as refreshing data, expanding cells, and navigating between databases and tables.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from API and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses database entries to show their tables, loads tables on demand.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables belonging to a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it as a table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML table from data array and appends to container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a cell, handling nulls, objects, and long text with expand/collapse.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expansion of cell content for long or object data.
